QuestInfo.name: Edelstein in Trouble
QuestInfo.0: The time to find the fourth Goddess Teardrop had come, and there was no time to slow down. The duo headed to #b#m325000000##k.
QuestInfo.1: After a strange inspection on their arrival in #m325000000#, the duo found out that #p2450003#, a high-ranking official's daughter, was kidnapped! Alpha and Beta couldn't help thinking this must be related to the Goddess Teardrops. They turned to the people of #b#m325090020##k for help.
QuestInfo.2: A person named #p2450002# held the answers they needed.

0.0: Things in Edelstein sure are gloomy right now. Our council president's daughter, #rGabrielle#k, was kidnapped from town. Sorry about the whole interrogation earlier, but everybody's on edge, ya know?
0.1: I heard that the kidnapper had #bblue hair#k! Not that I got a look... I get scared when people run too fast.
0.2: Maybe you should talk to the fella that told me about the kidnapper. His name's #bWonny#k, and he's usually around #b#m325090020##k.
